summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all major requirements: parser (JUnit XML + JSON), aggregator (totals + flaky detection), markdown rendering, workflow structure validation, and end-to-end execution via `act`. Unit tests are well-organized by component (parser.test.ts, aggregator.test.ts, markdown.test.ts, workflow.test.ts) with inline fixtures for readability. Integration tests (act.integration.test.ts) verify two realistic scenarios (flaky+failures, all-pass) with exact-value assertions and artifact generation. Workflow tests confirm YAML validity and actionlint compliance. Minor gaps: CLI error paths (exit code 1) lack explicit unit testing; boundary conditions (very large inputs, 1M tests) not tested; fixture content not validated in unit tests (only indirectly via act output matching). The RUN_ACT guard for cost control is well-designed but requires awareness. Parser handles entity decoding and status synonyms well. Flaky detection correctly ignores skipped tests. Overall demonstrates professional practices (independent tests, deterministic output, cost-conscious design) and would catch most regressions.
